-- | The sole closed internal controller program. Pinned input and observed
-- process owners enclose preparation and total caller coordination. No repo
-- discovery, ambient settings reload or independent process owner enters here.
module Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthController
  ( RpcBirthControllerError (..)
  , runRpcBirthController
  ) where

import Data.Bifunctor (first)
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthControllerInputs
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthCoordinator (RpcBirthCoordinationResult)
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthRequest
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthRollout

data RpcBirthControllerError
  = RpcBirthControllerInputRefused !RpcBirthControllerLoadError
  | RpcBirthControllerHostRefused !RpcBirthHostError
  deriving (Eq, Show)

runRpcBirthController
  :: RpcBirthControllerArguments
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerError RpcBirthCoordinationResult)
runRpcBirthController arguments = do
  loaded <- withRpcBirthControllerInputs arguments $ \inputs -> do
    operated <- withRpcBirthControllerProcesses inputs $ \processes -> do
      let preparation = rpcBirthControllerInputPreparation inputs
          request = rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation
      prepared <-
        prepareRpcBirthOnOperation
          processes
          (rpcBirthControllerRequestCoordination request)
          (rpcBirthControllerRequestRoot request)
          (rpcBirthControllerPreparedSettings preparation)
      case prepared of
        Left cause -> pure (Left (RpcBirthControllerHostRefused cause))
        Right held ->
          first RpcBirthControllerHostRefused
            <$> coordinatePreparedRpcBirthCallerOnOperation
              (rpcBirthControllerRequestCaller request)
              (rpcBirthControllerSourcePath inputs)
              held
    pure (first RpcBirthControllerInputRefused operated >>= id)
  pure (first RpcBirthControllerInputRefused loaded >>= id)

{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}

-- | Pinned same-descriptor input loading and the observed operation parent.
-- Decoding/preparation is bounded by the original work end. The callback's
-- physical interpreter owns work/cleanup; file leases alone grant no effects.
module Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthControllerInputs
  ( RpcBirthControllerArguments
  , RpcBirthControllerInputs
  , RpcBirthControllerLoadError (..)
  , parseRpcBirthControllerArguments
  , withRpcBirthControllerInputs
  , verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs
  , rpcBirthControllerInputPreparation
  , rpcBirthControllerSourcePath
  , withRpcBirthControllerProcesses
  , RpcBirthControllerLaunch
  , withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFiles
  , withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunch
  , RpcBirthControllerPublicationResult (..)
  , RpcBirthControllerPublicationDisposition (..)
  , RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt
  , withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunchRetiringUnsent
  , rpcBirthControllerLaunchArguments
  , rpcBirthControllerLaunchUnitNames
  , submitRpcBirthControllerLaunch
  , RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation
  , RpcBirthControllerFieldState (..)
  , HostOperationRole (..)
  , observeRpcBirthControllerField
  , observeRpcBirthControllerSubmission
  , RpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed
  , observeRpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed
  , RpcBirthControllerRetirement
  , withRpcBirthControllerRetirement
  , verifyRpcBirthControllerRetirement
  , RpcBirthControllerInputRetirementReceipt
  , retireRpcBirthControllerInputs
  , recoverNeverSentRpcBirthControllerInputs
  , rpcBirthControllerFieldState
  , rpcBirthControllerFieldRoleState
  ) where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar (MVar, modifyMVar_, newMVar, putMVar, tryTakeMVar)
import Control.Exception (IOException, finally, mask, try, uninterruptibleMask_)
import Control.Monad (unless, void)
import Control.Monad.Trans.Class (lift)
import Control.Monad.Trans.Except (ExceptT (..), runExceptT, throwE)
import Data.Bifunctor (first)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import GHC.IO.Exception (IOErrorType, ioe_errno, ioe_type)
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthClock qualified as Clock
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthCoordinator
  ( rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline
  , rpcBirthCoordinationScope
  )
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthPayload
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthRequest
import Prodbox.Repo (SiblingConfigSurface (ProductionTier0), siblingConfigPathForExecutable)
import Prodbox.Subprocess qualified as Subprocess
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostControllerArguments qualified as Arguments
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostControllerInputRetirement qualified as InputRetirement
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostControllerInputs qualified as Inputs
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostControllerPublication qualified as Publication
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostOperationFamily (HostOperationRole (..))
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostOperationFamily qualified as Operation
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostOperationRetirement qualified as Retirement
import Prodbox.Subprocess.KernelScope qualified as Kernel
import Prodbox.Subprocess.SystemdBus qualified as Bus
import Prodbox.Subprocess.SystemdIdentity qualified as Identity
import System.Posix.User (getEffectiveUserID)
import System.Timeout (timeout)

type RpcBirthControllerArguments = Arguments.HostControllerArguments

newtype RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation
  = RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation Operation.HostOperationInventory
  deriving (Eq, Show)

data RpcBirthControllerFieldState
  = ControllerFieldAbsent
  | ControllerFieldPresent
  | ControllerFieldUnobservable
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- This fresh budget grants reads only. Even complete manager absence supplies
-- no kernel/retirement receipt or closure of an uncertain admission.
observeRpcBirthControllerField
  :: Word64
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation)
observeRpcBirthControllerField readEnd request = do
  uid <- getEffectiveUserID
  result <-
    Bus.withSystemdBus
      readEnd
      ("/run/user/" <> show uid <> "/bus")
      ( \connection ->
          Operation.observeHostOperationField
            connection
            (Operation.hostOperationField (rpcBirthControllerRequestKey request))
      )
  pure (first ControllerLoadBusRefused (RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation <$> result))

-- Historical provenance is data, even when all original work clocks elapsed.
-- This neither reopens the sender nor proves that its queued request drained.
observeRpcBirthControllerSubmission
  :: Word64
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError Inputs.HostControllerSubmissionRecord)
observeRpcBirthControllerSubmission readEnd path request = runExceptT $ do
  record <-
    ExceptT $
      first (ControllerLoadInputsRefused . Operation.HostOperationInputsRefused)
        <$> Inputs.readHostControllerSubmission readEnd path (rpcBirthControllerRequestKey request)
  unless
    ( Inputs.hostControllerSubmissionWindow record == rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow request
        && Inputs.hostControllerSubmissionDomain record == rpcBirthControllerRequestDomain request
    )
    (throwE ControllerLoadPublicationMismatch)
  pure record

-- Only the original submission's native method-processing frontier. Physical
-- kernel/alarm absence and immutable-file retirement remain independent owners.
newtype RpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed
  = RpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed Operation.HostSubmissionCausalClosure

observeRpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed
  :: Word64
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError RpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed)
observeRpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed readEnd path request = runExceptT $ do
  record <- ExceptT (observeRpcBirthControllerSubmission readEnd path request)
  uid <- lift getEffectiveUserID
  observed <-
    ExceptT $
      first ControllerLoadBusRefused
        <$> Bus.withSystemdBus
          readEnd
          ("/run/user/" <> show uid <> "/bus")
          (\connection -> lift (Operation.observeHostSubmissionCausalClosure connection record))
  either
    (throwE . ControllerLoadInputsRefused)
    (pure . RpcBirthControllerSubmissionProcessed)
    observed

-- The callback borrows a fresh, exact-request physical observation owner. It
-- cannot renew work or delete launch inputs without their separate file owner.
newtype RpcBirthControllerRetirement = RpcBirthControllerRetirement Retirement.HostOperationRetirement

withRpcBirthControllerRetirement
  :: Word64
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> (RpcBirthControllerRetirement -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withRpcBirthControllerRetirement readEnd path request action =
  withMatchedControllerRetirement readEnd path request (\_ -> action . RpcBirthControllerRetirement)

withMatchedControllerRetirement
  :: Word64
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> (Inputs.HostControllerSubmissionRecord -> Retirement.HostOperationRetirement -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withMatchedControllerRetirement readEnd path request action = runExceptT $ do
  record <- ExceptT (observeRpcBirthControllerSubmission readEnd path request)
  uid <- lift getEffectiveUserID
  observed <-
    ExceptT $
      first ControllerLoadBusRefused
        <$> Bus.withSystemdBus
          readEnd
          ("/run/user/" <> show uid <> "/bus")
          ( \connection ->
              lift
                (Retirement.withHostOperationRetirement connection record (action record))
          )
  either (throwE . ControllerLoadRetirementRefused) pure observed

verifyRpcBirthControllerRetirement
  :: RpcBirthControllerRetirement -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError ())
verifyRpcBirthControllerRetirement (RpcBirthControllerRetirement owner) =
  first ControllerLoadRetirementRefused <$> Retirement.verifyHostOperationRetirement owner

-- A distinct fresh cleanup budget permits only the fixed publisher's exact
-- submitted payloads. Original work clocks stay expired; the public one-shot
-- submission/preparation/terminal fences remain for runtime-epoch retirement.
newtype RpcBirthControllerInputRetirementReceipt
  = RpcBirthControllerInputRetirementReceipt InputRetirement.HostInputRetirementReceipt

retireRpcBirthControllerInputs
  :: Word64
  -> FilePath
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError RpcBirthControllerInputRetirementReceipt)
retireRpcBirthControllerInputs cleanupEnd path request = do
  observed <-
    withMatchedControllerRetirement cleanupEnd path request $ \record owner ->
      InputRetirement.retireHostControllerInputs cleanupEnd owner record
  pure $
    observed
      >>= fmap RpcBirthControllerInputRetirementReceipt
        . first ControllerLoadInputRetirementRefused

recoverNeverSentRpcBirthControllerInputs
  :: Word64
  -> RpcBirthControllerRequest
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt)
recoverNeverSentRpcBirthControllerInputs cleanupEnd request = do
  recovered <-
    Publication.withRecoveredHostPublicationNeverSent
      cleanupEnd
      (rpcBirthControllerRequestKey request)
      recover
  pure (either (Left . ControllerLoadPublicationRefused) id recovered)
 where
  recover owner
    | Publication.hostPublicationNeverSentOriginalWorkEnd owner
        /= Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd (rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow request) =
        pure (Left ControllerLoadPublicationMismatch)
    | otherwise =
        (fmap RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt . first ControllerLoadInputRetirementRefused)
          <$> InputRetirement.retireNeverSentHostControllerInputs cleanupEnd owner

rpcBirthControllerFieldState :: RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation -> RpcBirthControllerFieldState
rpcBirthControllerFieldState observation
  | ControllerFieldUnobservable `elem` states = ControllerFieldUnobservable
  | ControllerFieldPresent `elem` states = ControllerFieldPresent
  | otherwise = ControllerFieldAbsent
 where
  states = map (rpcBirthControllerFieldRoleState observation) [minBound .. maxBound]

rpcBirthControllerFieldRoleState
  :: RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation -> HostOperationRole -> RpcBirthControllerFieldState
rpcBirthControllerFieldRoleState (RpcBirthControllerFieldObservation inventory) role =
  case Operation.hostOperationPresence inventory role of
    Operation.HostOperationAbsent -> ControllerFieldAbsent
    Operation.HostOperationPresent _ -> ControllerFieldPresent
    Operation.HostOperationUnobservable _ -> ControllerFieldUnobservable

data RpcBirthControllerInputs
  = RpcBirthControllerInputs !Operation.HostControllerProgram !RpcBirthControllerPreparation

data RpcBirthControllerLoadError
  = ControllerLoadArgumentsRefused !Arguments.HostControllerArgumentsError
  | ControllerLoadInputsRefused !Operation.HostOperationError
  | ControllerLoadRequestRefused !RpcBirthControllerRequestError
  | ControllerLoadSettingsRefused !RpcBirthSettingsPayloadError
  | ControllerLoadClockRefused !Clock.RpcBirthHostClockError
  | ControllerLoadBusRefused !Bus.BusError
  | ControllerLoadParentRefused !Kernel.KernelScopeError
  | ControllerLoadRetirementRefused !Retirement.RetirementError
  | ControllerLoadInputRetirementRefused !InputRetirement.InputRetirementError
  | ControllerLoadStreamsRefused !Subprocess.OwnedSubprocessError
  | ControllerLoadIoRefused !IOErrorType !(Maybe Int)
  | ControllerLoadExpired
  | ControllerLoadBudgetInvalid
  | ControllerLoadPublicationMismatch
  | ControllerLoadLaunchBusy
  | ControllerLoadPublicationRefused !Publication.HostControllerPublicationError
  deriving (Eq, Show)

parseRpcBirthControllerArguments
  :: [String] -> Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError RpcBirthControllerArguments
parseRpcBirthControllerArguments =
  first ControllerLoadArgumentsRefused
    . Arguments.parseHostControllerArguments

rpcBirthControllerInputPreparation :: RpcBirthControllerInputs -> RpcBirthControllerPreparation
rpcBirthControllerInputPreparation (RpcBirthControllerInputs _ preparation) = preparation

rpcBirthControllerSourcePath :: RpcBirthControllerInputs -> FilePath
rpcBirthControllerSourcePath (RpcBirthControllerInputs program _) =
  siblingConfigPathForExecutable
    ProductionTier0
    (Operation.hostControllerProgramExecutablePath program)

withRpcBirthControllerInputs
  :: RpcBirthControllerArguments
  -> (RpcBirthControllerInputs -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withRpcBirthControllerInputs arguments action = do
  result <-
    Operation.withPinnedHostControllerProgram
      ending
      (Arguments.controllerInputFingerprint arguments)
      (Arguments.controllerConfigurationPath arguments)
      (Arguments.controllerRequestPath arguments)
      use
  pure (either (Left . ControllerLoadInputsRefused) id result)
 where
  window = Arguments.controllerOriginalWindow arguments
  ending = Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd window
  use program = do
    prepared <- withinWork ending (loadInputs arguments program Nothing)
    case prepared of
      Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
      Right inputs -> Right <$> action inputs

loadInputs
  :: Arguments.HostControllerArguments
  -> Operation.HostControllerProgram
  -> Maybe RpcBirthControllerPreparation
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError RpcBirthControllerInputs)
loadInputs arguments program expected = runExceptT $ do
  bytes <-
    ExceptT (first ControllerLoadInputsRefused <$> Operation.readHostControllerProgramInputs program)
  case expected of
    Nothing -> pure ()
    Just preparation -> do
      config <-
        either
          (throwE . ControllerLoadSettingsRefused)
          pure
          (encodeRpcBirthControllerSettings (rpcBirthControllerPreparedSettings preparation))
      command <-
        either
          (throwE . ControllerLoadRequestRefused)
          pure
          (encodeRpcBirthControllerRequest (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation))
      unless
        ( rpcBirthSettingsBytes config == Operation.hostControllerConfigurationBytes bytes
            && rpcBirthControllerRequestBytes command == Operation.hostControllerRequestBytes bytes
        )
        (throwE ControllerLoadPublicationMismatch)
  request <-
    either
      (throwE . ControllerLoadRequestRefused)
      pure
      ( decodeRpcBirthControllerRequest
          (Arguments.controllerOperationKey arguments)
          (Arguments.controllerOriginalWindow arguments)
          (Operation.hostControllerRequestBytes bytes)
      )
  settings <-
    ExceptT
      ( first ControllerLoadSettingsRefused
          <$> decodeRpcBirthControllerSettings
            (rpcBirthCoordinationScope (rpcBirthControllerRequestCoordination request))
            (rpcBirthControllerRequestRoot request)
            (Operation.hostControllerConfigurationBytes bytes)
      )
  preparation <-
    ExceptT (first ControllerLoadRequestRefused <$> prepareRpcBirthControllerRequest request settings)
  let inputs = RpcBirthControllerInputs program preparation
  ExceptT (verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs inputs)
  pure inputs

withinWork
  :: Word64
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withinWork ending action = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  if now >= ending || (ending - now) `div` 1000 == 0
    then pure (Left ControllerLoadExpired)
    else do
      let micros = (ending - now) `div` 1000
      if toInteger micros > toInteger (maxBound :: Int)
        then pure (Left ControllerLoadBudgetInvalid)
        else do
          attempted <- try (timeout (fromIntegral micros) action)
          closing <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
          pure $ case attempted of
            Left (err :: IOException) -> Left (ControllerLoadIoRefused (ioe_type err) (fromIntegral <$> ioe_errno err))
            Right result
              | closing >= ending -> Left ControllerLoadExpired
              | otherwise -> maybe (Left ControllerLoadExpired) id result

verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs
  :: RpcBirthControllerInputs -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError ())
verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs (RpcBirthControllerInputs program preparation) = runExceptT $ do
  ExceptT (first ControllerLoadInputsRefused <$> Operation.verifyHostControllerProgram intent program)
  void
    ( ExceptT
        ( first ControllerLoadClockRefused
            <$> Clock.observeRpcBirthHostWindow
              (Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd window, Identity.hostExecutionOuterEnd window)
              (rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline (rpcBirthControllerRequestCoordination request))
        )
    )
  ExceptT (first ControllerLoadRequestRefused <$> verifyRpcBirthControllerRequestDomain request)
 where
  intent = rpcBirthControllerPreparedIntent preparation
  request = rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation
  window = rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow request

-- This is the existing physical lease, not a new interpretation of manager
-- metadata. It verifies the actual self PIDFD, invocation, cgroups and limits.
withRpcBirthControllerProcesses
  :: RpcBirthControllerInputs
  -> (Subprocess.OperationSubprocesses -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withRpcBirthControllerProcesses inputs@(RpcBirthControllerInputs program preparation) action = do
  checked <- verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs inputs
  case checked of
    Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
    Right () -> do
      uid <- getEffectiveUserID
      opened <-
        Bus.withSystemdBus
          (Identity.hostExecutionOuterEnd window)
          ("/run/user/" ++ show uid ++ "/bus")
          ( \connection -> do
              verifyConnectionDomain connection (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation)
              lift (Kernel.withObservedOperationParent connection intent program use)
          )
      pure $ case opened of
        Left cause -> Left (ControllerLoadBusRefused cause)
        Right (Left cause) -> Left (ControllerLoadParentRefused cause)
        Right (Right result) -> result
 where
  intent = rpcBirthControllerPreparedIntent preparation
  window = rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation)
  use parent = do
    checked <- verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs inputs
    case checked of
      Left cause -> pure (Right (Left cause))
      Right () -> case Subprocess.operationSubprocesses
        parent
        (rpcBirthControllerCommandLimits preparation)
        (rpcBirthControllerTransportLimits preparation) of
        Left cause -> pure (Right (Left (ControllerLoadStreamsRefused cause)))
        Right processes -> Right . Right <$> action processes

data RpcBirthControllerLaunch
  = RpcBirthControllerLaunch
      !Arguments.HostControllerArguments
      !RpcBirthControllerInputs
      !(Maybe Publication.HostPublicationOwner)
      !(MVar LaunchStage)

data LaunchStage = LaunchReady | LaunchSpent | LaunchClosed

-- Fixed-root exclusive publication preserves files on every callback exit.
-- No completion/submission reply is interpreted as a retirement capability.
withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunch
  :: RpcBirthControllerPreparation
  -> (RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunch preparation action = do
  result <- publishControllerLaunchWithClosing preparation action (const (pure ()))
  pure (result >>= fst)

data RpcBirthControllerPublicationResult value = RpcBirthControllerPublicationResult
  { rpcBirthPublicationOutcome :: !(Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
  , rpcBirthPublicationDisposition :: !RpcBirthControllerPublicationDisposition
  }

newtype RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt
  = RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt InputRetirement.HostNeverSentInputRetirementReceipt

data RpcBirthControllerPublicationDisposition
  = ControllerUnsubmittedInputsRetired !RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt
  | ControllerUnsubmittedInputsUnresolved !RpcBirthControllerLoadError
  | ControllerSubmittedInputsRetained

withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunchRetiringUnsent
  :: Word64
  -> RpcBirthControllerPreparation
  -> (RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError (RpcBirthControllerPublicationResult value))
withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunchRetiringUnsent cleanupEnd preparation action = do
  result <- publishControllerLaunchWithClosing preparation action close
  pure (fmap (uncurry RpcBirthControllerPublicationResult) result)
 where
  close disposition = case disposition of
    Publication.PublicationPossiblySent -> pure ControllerSubmittedInputsRetained
    Publication.PublicationNeverSent owner -> do
      retired <- InputRetirement.retireNeverSentHostControllerInputs cleanupEnd owner
      pure $ case retired of
        Left cause -> ControllerUnsubmittedInputsUnresolved (ControllerLoadInputRetirementRefused cause)
        Right receipt -> ControllerUnsubmittedInputsRetired (RpcBirthControllerNeverSentRetirementReceipt receipt)

publishControllerLaunchWithClosing
  :: RpcBirthControllerPreparation
  -> (RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO value)
  -> (Publication.HostPublicationDisposition -> IO closing)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value, closing))
publishControllerLaunchWithClosing preparation action closing = runExceptT $ do
  configuration <-
    either
      (throwE . ControllerLoadSettingsRefused)
      pure
      (encodeRpcBirthControllerSettings (rpcBirthControllerPreparedSettings preparation))
  request <-
    either
      (throwE . ControllerLoadRequestRefused)
      pure
      (encodeRpcBirthControllerRequest original)
  ExceptT
    ( first ControllerLoadPublicationRefused
        <$> Publication.withPublishedHostControllerOwner
          (Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd (rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow original))
          (rpcBirthControllerRequestKey original)
          (rpcBirthSettingsBytes configuration)
          (rpcBirthControllerRequestBytes request)
          ( \owner ->
              let (config, command) = Publication.hostPublicationPaths owner
               in withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFilesOwned (Just owner) preparation config command action
          )
          closing
    )
 where
  original = rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation

-- The caller owns these immutable files through independent family absence.
-- Scope release closes descriptors; it never deletes uncertain launch inputs.
withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFiles
  :: RpcBirthControllerPreparation
  -> FilePath
  -> FilePath
  -> (RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFiles = withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFilesOwned Nothing

withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFilesOwned
  :: Maybe Publication.HostPublicationOwner
  -> RpcBirthControllerPreparation
  -> FilePath
  -> FilePath
  -> (RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError value)
withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFilesOwned publication expected configuration request action = do
  result <- Operation.withCurrentHostControllerProgram ending configuration request use
  pure (either (Left . ControllerLoadInputsRefused) id result)
 where
  original = rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest expected
  window = rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow original
  ending = Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd window
  use program = do
    let arguments =
          Arguments.HostControllerArguments
            configuration
            request
            (Operation.hostControllerProgramInputFingerprint program)
            (rpcBirthControllerRequestKey original)
            window
    loaded <- withinWork ending (loadInputs arguments program (Just expected))
    case loaded of
      Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
      Right inputs -> do
        gate <- newMVar LaunchReady
        (Right <$> action (RpcBirthControllerLaunch arguments inputs publication gate))
          `finally` uninterruptibleMask_ (modifyMVar_ gate (const (pure LaunchClosed)))

rpcBirthControllerLaunchArguments
  :: RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError [String])
rpcBirthControllerLaunchArguments (RpcBirthControllerLaunch arguments inputs _ _) = do
  checked <- verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs inputs
  pure (Arguments.renderHostControllerArguments arguments <$ checked)

rpcBirthControllerLaunchUnitNames :: RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> [String]
rpcBirthControllerLaunchUnitNames (RpcBirthControllerLaunch _ (RpcBirthControllerInputs _ preparation) _ _) =
  map
    (Operation.hostOperationUnitName (rpcBirthControllerPreparedIntent preparation))
    [minBound .. maxBound]

-- Submission is not a running descriptor, Authority admission or absence proof.
submitRpcBirthControllerLaunch
  :: RpcBirthControllerLaunch -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError ())
submitRpcBirthControllerLaunch (RpcBirthControllerLaunch _ inputs publication gate) = mask $ \restore -> do
  acquired <- tryTakeMVar gate
  case acquired of
    Nothing -> pure (Left ControllerLoadLaunchBusy)
    Just LaunchClosed ->
      putMVar gate LaunchClosed
        >> pure
          ( Left
              (ControllerLoadInputsRefused (Operation.HostOperationInputsRefused Inputs.ControllerInputsClosed))
          )
    Just LaunchSpent ->
      putMVar gate LaunchSpent
        >> pure (Left (ControllerLoadInputsRefused Operation.HostOperationAlreadyAttempted))
    Just LaunchReady ->
      restore (submitWithPublication publication inputs) `finally` putMVar gate LaunchSpent

submitWithPublication
  :: Maybe Publication.HostPublicationOwner
  -> RpcBirthControllerInputs
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError ())
submitWithPublication publication inputs = case publication of
  Nothing -> submitUsingPublication Nothing inputs
  Just owner -> do
    submitted <-
      Publication.withHostPublicationSubmission
        owner
        (\permit -> submitUsingPublication (Just permit) inputs)
    pure (either (Left . ControllerLoadPublicationRefused) id submitted)

submitUsingPublication
  :: Maybe Publication.HostPublicationSubmission
  -> RpcBirthControllerInputs
  -> IO (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError ())
submitUsingPublication publication inputs@(RpcBirthControllerInputs program preparation) = do
  checked <- verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs inputs
  case checked of
    Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
    Right () -> do
      uid <- getEffectiveUserID
      result <-
        Bus.withSystemdBus
          (Identity.hostExecutionOuterEnd window)
          ("/run/user/" ++ show uid ++ "/bus")
          ( \connection -> do
              verifyConnectionDomain connection (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation)
              lift $ case publication of
                Nothing -> Operation.submitHostOperationFamily connection intent program
                Just permit -> Operation.submitPublishedHostOperationFamily permit connection intent program
          )
      pure $ case result of
        Left cause -> Left (ControllerLoadBusRefused cause)
        Right submitted -> first ControllerLoadInputsRefused submitted
 where
  intent = rpcBirthControllerPreparedIntent preparation
  window = rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation)

verifyConnectionDomain :: Bus.BusConnection -> RpcBirthControllerRequest -> Bus.BusAction ()
verifyConnectionDomain connection request = do
  current <-
    Bus.observeManagerDomain
      ( Bus.systemdBusWithin
          (Identity.hostExecutionWorkEnd (rpcBirthControllerRequestWindow request))
          connection
      )
  unless (current == rpcBirthControllerRequestDomain request) (throwE Bus.BusManagerIdentityRefused)

-- | Closed wire arguments shared by the family declaration and its loader.
-- These values grant neither a file lease nor physical/Authority admission.
module Prodbox.Subprocess.HostControllerArguments
  ( HostControllerArguments (..)
  , HostControllerArgumentsError (..)
  , parseHostControllerArguments
  , renderHostControllerArguments
  ) where

import Control.Monad (unless)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Numeric.Natural (Natural)
import Prodbox.Subprocess.HostControllerInputs
  ( HostControllerInputFingerprint
  , hostControllerInputFingerprintText
  , parseHostControllerInputFingerprint
  )
import Prodbox.Subprocess.SystemdIdentity
import System.FilePath (isAbsolute, normalise, splitDirectories, takeFileName)

data HostControllerArguments = HostControllerArguments
  { controllerConfigurationPath :: !FilePath
  , controllerRequestPath :: !FilePath
  , controllerInputFingerprint :: !HostControllerInputFingerprint
  , controllerOperationKey :: !HostExecutionKey
  , controllerOriginalWindow :: !HostExecutionWindow
  }
  deriving (Eq)

instance Show HostControllerArguments where
  showsPrec precedence = showsPrec precedence . renderHostControllerArguments

data HostControllerArgumentsError
  = ControllerArgumentsShapeInvalid
  | ControllerArgumentsPathInvalid
  | ControllerArgumentsFingerprintInvalid
  | ControllerArgumentsKeyInvalid
  | ControllerArgumentsClockInvalid
  deriving (Eq, Show)

parseHostControllerArguments
  :: [String] -> Either HostControllerArgumentsError HostControllerArguments
parseHostControllerArguments arguments = case arguments of
  [ "--config"
    , configuration
    , "--request"
    , request
    , "--input-fingerprint"
    , fingerprintText
    , "--operation-key"
    , keyText
    , "--outer-ns"
    , outerText
    , "--work-ns"
    , workText
    , "--hard-ns"
    , hardText
    , "--stop-ns"
    , stopText
    , "--finish-ns"
    , finishText
    ] -> do
      unless (validPath configuration && validPath request) (Left ControllerArgumentsPathInvalid)
      fingerprint <-
        maybe
          (Left ControllerArgumentsFingerprintInvalid)
          Right
          (parseHostControllerInputFingerprint fingerprintText)
      key <- maybe (Left ControllerArgumentsKeyInvalid) Right (hostExecutionKeyFromText keyText)
      outer <- clock outerText
      work <- clock workText
      hard <- clock hardText
      stop <- clock stopText
      finish <- clock finishText
      window <-
        maybe (Left ControllerArgumentsClockInvalid) Right (hostExecutionWindow outer work hard stop finish)
      pure (HostControllerArguments configuration request fingerprint key window)
  _ -> Left ControllerArgumentsShapeInvalid
 where
  validPath value =
    length (take 4097 value) <= 4096
      && '\0' `notElem` value
      && isAbsolute value
      && normalise value == value
      && all (`notElem` [".", ".."]) (splitDirectories value)
      && takeFileName value `notElem` ["", ".", ".."]
  clock value = do
    let canonical = case value of
          [] -> False
          '0' : _ -> False
          _ -> True
    unless
      (length (take 21 value) <= 20 && canonical && all (\c -> c >= '0' && c <= '9') value)
      (Left ControllerArgumentsClockInvalid)
    let number = foldl' (\total digit -> total * 10 + fromIntegral (fromEnum digit - 48)) 0 value :: Natural
    unless
      (number > 0 && number < fromIntegral (maxBound :: Word64))
      (Left ControllerArgumentsClockInvalid)
    pure (fromIntegral number)

renderHostControllerArguments :: HostControllerArguments -> [String]
renderHostControllerArguments arguments =
  [ "--config"
  , controllerConfigurationPath arguments
  , "--request"
  , controllerRequestPath arguments
  , "--input-fingerprint"
  , hostControllerInputFingerprintText (controllerInputFingerprint arguments)
  , "--operation-key"
  , hostExecutionKeyText (controllerOperationKey arguments)
  ]
    <> concatMap
      (\(flag, field) -> [flag, show (field (controllerOriginalWindow arguments))])
      [ ("--outer-ns", hostExecutionOuterEnd)
      , ("--work-ns", hostExecutionWorkEnd)
      , ("--hard-ns", hostExecutionHardEnd)
      , ("--stop-ns", hostExecutionStopEnd)
      , ("--finish-ns", hostExecutionFinishEnd)
      ]

module Prodbox.Repo
  ( ConfigPaths (..)
  , SiblingConfigSurface (..)
  , canonicalConfigPaths
  , findRepoRoot
  , resolveSiblingConfigPath
  , siblingConfigPathForExecutable
  , resolveTestTopologyConfigPath
  , resolveTier0ConfigPath
  , testTopologyConfigFileName
  , tier0ConfigFileName
  )
where

import System.Directory
  ( doesFileExist
  , getCurrentDirectory
  )
import System.Environment (getExecutablePath)
import System.FilePath
  ( takeDirectory
  , (</>)
  )

-- | Repo-root-relative Dhall paths the binary still resolves against the
-- repository root: the GENERATED schema and the RETIRED legacy seed. The
-- Tier-0 @prodbox.dhall@ is NOT here — it is binary-sibling
-- ('resolveTier0ConfigPath'), not repo-root (Sprint 1.48; config_doctrine.md
-- §2/§3).
data ConfigPaths = ConfigPaths
  { configDhallPath :: FilePath
  , configSchemaPath :: FilePath
  }
  deriving (Eq, Show)

data SiblingConfigSurface
  = ProductionTier0
  | TestTopology
  deriving (Eq, Show)

findRepoRoot :: IO (Either String FilePath)
findRepoRoot = do
  currentDir <- getCurrentDirectory
  repoMarkerPresent <- hasRepoMarkers currentDir
  pure $
    if repoMarkerPresent
      then Right currentDir
      else Left "Current working directory is not the repository root."

hasRepoMarkers :: FilePath -> IO Bool
hasRepoMarkers candidate = do
  cabalPresent <- doesFileExist (candidate </> "prodbox.cabal")
  planPresent <- doesFileExist (candidate </> "DEVELOPMENT_PLAN/README.md")
  pure (cabalPresent && planPresent)

canonicalConfigPaths :: FilePath -> ConfigPaths
canonicalConfigPaths repoRoot =
  ConfigPaths
    { configDhallPath = repoRoot </> "prodbox-config.dhall"
    , configSchemaPath = repoRoot </> "prodbox-config-types.dhall"
    }

-- | The Tier-0 config filename, identical in every context (host, container,
-- test harness) per config_doctrine.md §2/§3. The binary owns this file and
-- resolves it beside its own executable.
tier0ConfigFileName :: FilePath
tier0ConfigFileName = "prodbox.dhall"

testTopologyConfigFileName :: FilePath
testTopologyConfigFileName = "prodbox.test.dhall"

-- | Resolve the Tier-0 @prodbox.dhall@ at the BINARY-SIBLING path — the file
-- beside the running executable (e.g. @.build\/prodbox.dhall@), the same
-- filename in every context, never the repository root and never a @--config@
-- flag (config_doctrine.md §2 "Single Dhall surface per binary instance", §3
-- "Canonical paths"). @repoRoot@ is the fallback anchor, used only when the
-- executable directory cannot be determined. Sprint 1.48.
resolveTier0ConfigPath :: FilePath -> IO FilePath
resolveTier0ConfigPath = resolveSiblingConfigPath ProductionTier0

resolveTestTopologyConfigPath :: FilePath -> IO FilePath
resolveTestTopologyConfigPath = resolveSiblingConfigPath TestTopology

resolveSiblingConfigPath :: SiblingConfigSurface -> FilePath -> IO FilePath
resolveSiblingConfigPath surface repoRoot = do
  executable <- getExecutablePath
  pure $
    if null (takeDirectory executable)
      then repoRoot </> siblingConfigFileName surface
      else siblingConfigPathForExecutable surface executable

-- The caller may supply a descriptor-pinned executable identity. This is
-- path metadata only; it neither reloads configuration nor grants a write.
siblingConfigPathForExecutable :: SiblingConfigSurface -> FilePath -> FilePath
siblingConfigPathForExecutable surface executable =
  takeDirectory executable </> siblingConfigFileName surface

siblingConfigFileName :: SiblingConfigSurface -> FilePath
siblingConfigFileName surface =
  case surface of
    ProductionTier0 -> tier0ConfigFileName
    TestTopology -> testTopologyConfigFileName

module ControlPlaneRpcBirthController (rpcBirthControllerSuite) where

import Control.Monad (forM_)
import Data.Either (isLeft)
import Options.Applicative (ParserResult (..), defaultPrefs, execParserPure, renderFailure)
import Prodbox.App (canRunWithoutRepoRoot)
import Prodbox.CLI.Command (CommandRequest (..), NativeCommand (..))

import Prodbox.CLI.Spec (CommandSpec (options), OptionSpec (longName, required), findCommandSpec)
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthController (runRpcBirthController)
import Prodbox.ControlPlane.RpcAdmissionBirthControllerInputs (parseRpcBirthControllerArguments)

import TestSupport

rpcBirthControllerSuite :: SuiteBuilder ()
rpcBirthControllerSuite = describe "closed RPC birth controller CLI" $ do
  it "parses the shared canonical envelope into the registered native command" $ do
    let expected = must (parseRpcBirthControllerArguments arguments)
        command = NativeRpcBirthController expected
    parseCommand True (token : arguments) `shouldBe` Right (RunNative command)
    canRunWithoutRepoRoot command `shouldBe` True
    commandPrerequisites command `shouldBe` []

  it "registers all nine required options for normal help and introspection" $ do
    case findCommandSpec [token] of
      Nothing -> expectationFailure "controller leaf missing from the canonical registry"
      Just spec -> do
        map longName (options spec)
          `shouldBe` [ "config"
                     , "request"
                     , "input-fingerprint"
                     , "operation-key"
                     , "outer-ns"
                     , "work-ns"
                     , "hard-ns"
                     , "stop-ns"
                     , "finish-ns"
                     ]
        map required (options spec) `shouldBe` replicate 9 True

  forM_
    [ ("missing pair", take 16 arguments)
    , ("duplicate pair", take 2 arguments ++ arguments)
    , ("reordered pair", take 2 (drop 2 arguments) ++ take 2 arguments ++ drop 4 arguments)
    , ("unknown tail", arguments ++ ["--source", "/unowned/config"])
    , ("relative path", replace 1 "relative.cbor")
    , ("noncanonical path", replace 3 "/tmp/a/../request.cbor")
    , ("invalid fingerprint", replace 5 (replicate 64 'A'))
    , ("invalid key", replace 7 "unowned")
    , ("leading-zero clock", replace 11 "0100")
    , ("inverted clock", replace 17 "600")
    , ("overflow clock", replace 9 "18446744073709551616")
    ]
    $ \(label, rejected) ->
      it ("rejects " <> label <> " through the ordinary argv validator") $
        parseCommand True (token : rejected) `shouldSatisfy` isLeft

  it "also validates the complete envelope inside the registered parser binding" $
    parseCommand False (token : replace 17 "600") `shouldSatisfy` isLeft

  forM_ ["--help", "-h"] $ \flag ->
    it ("permits normal " <> flag <> " without opening an input") $ do
      validateCommandArgv [token, flag] `shouldBe` Right ()
      case execParserPure defaultPrefs parserInfo [token, flag] of
        Failure failure -> do
          let (message, _) = renderFailure failure "prodbox"
          message `shouldContain` "--input-fingerprint"
          message `shouldContain` "--finish-ns"
        _ -> expectationFailure "controller help did not use the canonical parser"

  it "refuses an expired data envelope without admitting a controller" $ do
    result <- runRpcBirthController (must (parseRpcBirthControllerArguments arguments))
    result `shouldSatisfy` isLeft
 where
  replace position value = take position arguments ++ [value] ++ drop (position + 1) arguments

token :: String
token = "internal-rpc-birth-controller"

arguments :: [String]
arguments =
  [ "--config"
  , "/tmp/rpc-birth-controller-settings.cbor"
  , "--request"
  , "/tmp/rpc-birth-controller-request.cbor"
  , "--input-fingerprint"
  , replicate 64 'a'
  , "--operation-key"
  , replicate 64 'b'
  , "--outer-ns"
  , "500"
  , "--work-ns"
  , "100"
  , "--hard-ns"
  , "200"
  , "--stop-ns"
  , "300"
  , "--finish-ns"
  , "400"
  ]

parseCommand :: Bool -> [String] -> Either String CommandRequest
parseCommand validate argv = do
  if validate then validateCommandArgv argv else Right ()
  case execParserPure defaultPrefs parserInfo argv of
    Success parsed -> Right (optRequest parsed)
    Failure failure -> Left (fst (renderFailure failure "prodbox"))
    CompletionInvoked _ -> Left "completion requested"

must :: (Show errorValue) => Either errorValue value -> value
must = either (error . show) id

        results <- processGeneratedArtifacts root True

        updates `shouldBe` [(root </> path, expected, True)]
        forM_ updates $ \(target, contents, _) -> writeFile target contents

right :: (Show err) => Either err value -> IO value
right = either (fail . show) pure

main :: IO ()
main = do
  args <- getArgs
  case args of
    ["launch", mode, path, tools] | mode `elem` ["initial", "registered"] -> do
      directory <- makeAbsolute path
      helper <- makeAbsolute tools
      launch mode directory helper
    "internal-rpc-birth-controller" : _ -> delegate
    _ -> fail "closed dispatcher fixture invocation refused"

-- Authored boundaries enter before App.main. Its real argv parser, pinned
-- loader and native/process/session/coordination interpreters stay unchanged.
delegate :: IO ()
delegate = do
  binaryDirectory <- takeDirectory <$> getExecutablePath
  directory <- readFile (binaryDirectory </> "dispatcher-case")
  port <- readFile (directory </> "remote-port")
  runtime <- getEnv "RUNTIME_DIRECTORY"
  present <- doesDirectoryExist runtime
  unless present (fail "managed runtime directory was not created")
  writeFile (directory </> "managed-runtime") runtime
  inherited <- getEnv "PATH"
  setEnv "PATH" (directory </> "tools" ++ ":" ++ inherited)
  setEnv "HOME" (directory </> "fixture-home")
  setEnv "RPC_BIRTH_FIXTURE_DIRECTORY" directory
  setEnv "RPC_BIRTH_FIXTURE_MODE" "owned-total-harness"
  setEnv "RPC_BIRTH_FIXTURE_REMOTE_PORT" port
  setCurrentDirectory (directory </> "outside")
  outcome <- try App.main :: IO (Either ExitCode ())
  writeFile (directory </> "dispatcher-outcome") (show outcome)
  either exitWith pure outcome

settingsFor
  :: FilePath -> FilePath -> VaultAddress -> RpcBirthConfig -> IO (S.ValidatedSettings, S.ConfigFile)
settingsFor root directory (VaultAddress address) registration = do
  let context = Tier0.context syntheticProjectConfig
      input = S.DeploymentContextInput "home" address (Tier0.minio_endpoint context) registration
      capacity = S.capacity syntheticConfigFile
      plan = C.resource_plan capacity
      selected = filter ((`elem` C.guaranteedControlPlaneProfileIds) . C.profile_id) (C.workload_profiles plan)
      ids = map C.profile_id selected
      config =
        syntheticConfigFile
          { S.storage =
              (S.storage syntheticConfigFile) {S.manual_pv_host_root = Text.pack (makeRelative root directory)}
          , S.capacity =
              capacity
                { C.resource_plan =
                    plan {C.host_capacity = C.ResourceVector 6000 12000 60000 60000, C.workload_profiles = selected}
                , C.runtime_memory_profiles =
                    filter ((`elem` ids) . C.runtime_profile_id) (C.runtime_memory_profiles capacity)
                }
          }
  settings <- right =<< S.validateConfigWithContext root input config
  pure (settings, config)

launch :: String -> FilePath -> FilePath -> IO ()
launch mode directory fakeTools = do
  root <- getCurrentDirectory
  binaryDirectory <- takeDirectory <$> getExecutablePath
  forM_ ["tools", "outside", "fixture-home/.kube"] $ \name -> createDirectoryIfMissing True (directory </> name)
  forM_ ["helm", "kubectl", "docker"] $ \name -> createLink fakeTools (directory </> "tools" </> name)
  writeFile (binaryDirectory </> "dispatcher-case") directory
  Lazy.writeFile (directory </> "home.json") (encode homeConfig)
  Lazy.writeFile (directory </> "fixture-home/.kube/config") (encode homeConfig)
  scope <- right (mkAuthorityScope "home")
  now <- rpcBirthSystemTime
  operationNonce <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  let deadline = authorityTimeFromMicros (authorityTimeMicros now + 60000000)
      operationKey = Text.justifyRight 32 '0' (Text.pack (showHex operationNonce ""))
  serving <- newIORef Nothing
  let observeServing = do
        present <- doesFileExist (directory </> "applied-values.json")
        if not present
          then pure Nothing
          else do
            cached <- readIORef serving
            case cached of
              Just value -> pure (Just value)
              Nothing -> do
                value <- right . eitherDecodeStrict' =<< BS.readFile (directory </> "applied-values.json")
                text <- case value of
                  Object fields
                    | Just (Object cfg) <- KM.lookup "config" fields
                    , Just (String role) <- KM.lookup "roleDhall" cfg ->
                        pure role
                  _ -> fail "applied role missing"
                config <- Dhall.input Dhall.auto text
                selected <-
                  right
                    ( validateRpcBirthConfig
                        LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
                        scope
                        (Runtime.rpc_registration (config :: Runtime.ControlPlaneConfig))
                    )
                writeIORef serving (Just selected)
                pure (Just selected)
      withWire action =
        if mode == "registered"
          then withRpcBirthPreparedCoordinatorWireFixtureForKey operationKey deadline observeServing $ \registration observer _ _ wire probe -> action registration (Just observer) wire probe
          else withRpcBirthCoordinatorWireFixture deadline observeServing $ \_ _ wire probe -> action RpcBirthConfigLegacy Nothing wire probe
  withRpcBirthCallerVaultFixture LifecycleAuthorityTestHarness CallerVaultHealthy $ \address paths ->
    withWire $ \registration observer inner probe -> do
      (settings, config) <- settingsFor root directory address registration
      let context =
            (Tier0.context syntheticProjectConfig)
              { Tier0.cluster_id = "home"
              , Tier0.vault_address = case address of VaultAddress value -> value
              }
          project =
            syntheticProjectConfig
              { Tier0.parameters = Tier0.configFileToTier0Parameters config
              , Tier0.context = context
              }
          source = tier0FixturePath binaryDirectory
      writeTier0Fixture binaryDirectory (tier0Fixture project)
      case registration of
        RpcBirthConfigLegacy -> pure ()
        RpcBirthConfigRegistered _ -> do
          let publication = tier0RpcBirthPublicationAtPath scope source (\_ _ -> fail "fixture setup cannot deploy")
          right =<< coordinationPublishSource publication deadline RpcBirthConfigLegacy registration
      let image =
            ResolvedCustomImage
              "registry.test/prodbox/runtime"
              "held-native"
              (Just ("sha256:" ++ replicate 64 'a'))
              (Just ("sha256:" ++ replicate 64 'b'))
          observers =
            ChartPlanObservers
              (const (pure (Right (Just image))))
              (pure (Right (KubernetesApiEgressCoordinate ["10.0.0.1"] 6443)))
      planned <-
        right
          =<< buildChartDeploymentPlanForSubstrateWithObservers
            observers
            SubstrateHomeLocal
            root
            settings
            "lifecycle-authority"
            Map.empty
            Map.empty
      binding <- case concatMap chartReleasePlanStorageBindings (chartDeploymentPlanReleases planned) of
        [value] -> pure value
        _ -> fail "journal binding missing"
      Lazy.writeFile (directory </> "claim.json") (encode (claimFor binding))
      Lazy.writeFile (directory </> "volume.json") (encode (volumeFor binding))
      let wire method headers url bytes
            | isRpcOwnBindingQuery bytes = do
                current <- maybe (fail "initial mode cannot discover") (observeRpcKeyRegistry >=> right) observer
                query <- right (decodeRpcOwnBindingQuery scope bytes)
                hint <- right (selectRpcOwnBindingHint query current)
                pure (Right (200, encodeRpcOwnBindingHint hint))
            | otherwise = inner method headers url bytes
      withAuthorityListener "healthy" wire $ \port -> do
        writeFile (directory </> "remote-port") (show port)
        request <- right (mkRpcBirthCoordinationRequest scope deadline 1 operationKey)
        started <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        let outer = started + 50000000000
            work = started + 40000000000
            hard = started + 42000000000
            stop = started + 45000000000
            finish = started + 47000000000
        window <- maybe (fail "original window") pure (P.hostExecutionWindow outer work hard stop finish)
        domain <- right =<< observeRpcBirthControllerManagerDomain work
        command <-
          right
            ( mkRpcBirthControllerRequest
                LifecycleAuthorityTestHarness
                domain
                root
                settings
                request
                window
                profile
            )
        prepared <- right =<< prepareRpcBirthControllerRequest command settings
        result <- withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunch prepared $ \submission -> do
          let units = rpcBirthControllerLaunchUnitNames submission
          Lazy.writeFile
            (directory </> "field.json")
            ( encode
                ( object
                    [ "units" .= units
                    , "outer_ns" .= outer
                    , "work_ns" .= work
                    , "hard_ns" .= hard
                    , "stop_ns" .= stop
                    , "finish_ns" .= finish
                    ]
                )
            )
          right =<< submitRpcBirthControllerLaunch submission
          observeClosing work finish command
          runtime <- readFile (directory </> "managed-runtime")
          retained <- doesDirectoryExist runtime
          unless (not retained) (fail "dispatcher workspace survived its family")
          outcome <- readFile (directory </> "dispatcher-outcome")
          unless (outcome == "Left ExitSuccess") (fail ("production dispatcher refused: " ++ outcome))
          (phase, frames) <- probe
          unless
            ( phase == BirthCommitted
                && all (== deadline) frames
                && length frames == if mode == "registered" then 44 else 12
            )
            (fail "production dispatcher changed commitment/frame bounds")
          events <- lines <$> readFile (directory </> "events")
          let forwards = length (filter (== "kubectl port-forward") events)
          unless (forwards == 1) (fail "dispatcher opened another forward")
          vaultPaths <- readIORef paths
          unless
            (length (filter (== "/v1/auth/kubernetes/login") vaultPaths) == 1)
            (fail "dispatcher replaced its cached session")
          cwdSchemas <-
            mapM
              (doesFileExist . ((directory </> "outside") </>))
              ["prodbox-config-types.dhall", "test-secrets-types.dhall"]
          unless (not (or cwdSchemas)) (fail "dispatcher materialized cwd schemas")
          Lazy.writeFile
            (directory </> "dispatcher.json")
            ( encode
                ( object
                    [ "phase" .= show phase
                    , "frames" .= length frames
                    , "forwards" .= forwards
                    , "original_bounds" .= True
                    , "outside_repo" .= True
                    , "cwd_schemas_absent" .= True
                    , "all_six_units_absent" .= True
                    ]
                )
            )
        right result

observeClosing :: Word64 -> Word64 -> RpcBirthControllerRequest -> IO ()
observeClosing work finish request = do
  uid <- getEffectiveUserID
  let group =
        "/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-"
          ++ show uid
          ++ ".slice/user@"
          ++ show uid
          ++ ".service/prodboxrpcbirth.slice"
      flags = Posix.defaultFileFlags {Posix.directory = True, Posix.nofollow = True, Posix.cloexec = True}
  waitUntil work (doesDirectoryExist group)
  bracket (Posix.openFd group Posix.ReadOnly flags) Posix.closeFd $ \held -> do
    waitUntil finish $ do
      observed <- right =<< observeRpcBirthControllerField finish request
      pure (rpcBirthControllerFieldState observed == ControllerFieldAbsent)
    waitUntil finish $ do
      target <- readSymbolicLink ("/proc/self/fd/" ++ show held)
      result <-
        try
          ( bracket
              ( Posix.openFdAt
                  (Just held)
                  "cgroup.events"
                  Posix.ReadOnly
                  Posix.defaultFileFlags {Posix.nofollow = True, Posix.cloexec = True}
              )
              Posix.closeFd
              (const (pure ()))
          )
          :: IO (Either IOException ())
      pure (" (deleted)" `isSuffixOf` target && either isDoesNotExistError (const False) result)

waitUntil :: Word64 -> IO Bool -> IO ()
waitUntil ending observation = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  unless (now < ending) (fail "original dispatcher observation bound expired")
  ready <- observation
  unless ready (threadDelay 1000 >> waitUntil ending observation)

withAuthorityListener :: String -> Client.ControlPlaneTransport -> (Int -> IO value) -> IO value
withAuthorityListener mode wire action = Net.withSocketsDo $ bracket open Net.close $ \listener -> do
  address <- Net.getSocketName listener
  port <- case address of
    Net.SockAddrInet value _ -> pure (fromIntegral value)
    _ -> fail "fixture Authority listener is not IPv4"
  Async.withAsync (forever (serve listener)) $ \workerThread -> do
    Async.link workerThread
    action port
 where
  open = do
    listener <- Net.socket Net.AF_INET Net.Stream Net.defaultProtocol
    Net.setSocketOption listener Net.ReuseAddr 1
    Net.bind listener (Net.SockAddrInet 0 (Net.tupleToHostAddress (127, 0, 0, 1)))
    Net.listen listener 8
    pure listener
  serve listener = bracket (Net.accept listener) (Net.close . fst) $ \(connection, _) -> do
    raw <- receive connection BS.empty
    request <-
      maybe (fail "invalid Authority fixture framing") pure (Server.parseControlPlaneRequest raw)
    case Server.parsedRequestPath request of
      "/readyz" -> do
        let (status, body) = case mode of
              "readiness-oversized" -> (ReplyOk, BS.replicate 4097 120)
              "readiness-unavailable" -> (ReplyServiceUnavailable, "not ready")
              _ -> (ReplyOk, "ready")
        NetBytes.sendAll connection (Server.renderHttpResponse status body)
      path | path `elem` ["/v1/authority/peer/observe", "/v1/migration/apply"] -> do
        response <- wire "POST" [] ("http://home.test" ++ path) (Server.parsedRequestBody request) >>= right
        let (code, actualBody) = response
            body =
              if mode `elem` ["response-overflow", "owned-total-response-overflow"] && path == "/v1/migration/apply"
                then BS.replicate 65537 120
                else actualBody
        status <- maybe (fail "fixture status") pure (replyStatusFromCode code)
        NetBytes.sendAll connection (Server.renderHttpResponse status body)
      _ -> fail "fixture Authority received an unregistered route"
  receive connection accumulated
    | BS.length accumulated > 70000 = fail "Authority fixture request bound exceeded"
    | otherwise = case Server.inspectControlPlaneRequestFraming accumulated of
        Left cause -> fail (show cause)
        Right (Server.ControlPlaneFramingComplete raw) -> pure raw
        Right Server.ControlPlaneFramingIncomplete -> do
          chunk <- NetBytes.recv connection 4096
          if BS.null chunk then fail "Authority fixture EOF" else receive connection (accumulated <> chunk)
